verdict.rationale: Cake documents permissioned views (admin-controlled 'My Cake Portal' vs Company View) and some document handling (share certificates, uploaded/linked certificates) that gesture toward controlled sharing, but there is no evidence of a dedicated diligence 'data room' feature bundling documents (SAFEs, board consents, agreements) for external counsel/investor review beyond certificate management. Missing for 10: explicit data-room/document-repository feature, counsel-specific sharing workflow, evidence of bundling legal/financial documents alongside cap table views for diligence.
